meta.scoring: UEFA Champions League Fantasy rules, derived from the official feed's own points (557/557 players who played matched exactly)
meta.team_strength_source: GoalIQ Champions League model (all 36 clubs on one scale)
meta.attack_basis: Share of the club's expected goals and assists per 90 minutes in its domestic league (Understat, five major leagues). Clubs outside those leagues: goals and starting line-ups in UEFA matches, shrunk harder.
meta.minutes_basis: Starts and substitute appearances from the domestic league or UEFA line-ups, normalised to 11 starters per club; official feed availability applied to the next matchday.
